lap_join_meteo()

Time-series indicators

Per-well metrics computed from the hydrograph. See vignette("indicators") for the long-form guide.

lap_indicators()
Compute time-series indicators per well
lap_add_indicators()
Append time-series indicators to a well-level table
lap_indicator_registry()
The available time-series indicators
lap_indicator_change()
Compute indicators over several time windows
lap_indicator_delta()
Difference indicators between two periods
lap_ind_amplitude()
Groundwater-level amplitude
lap_ind_climate_signal()
Climate response time and the climate-removed (anthropogenic) trend
lap_ind_drought()
Drought characterisation from a standardised index
lap_ind_drought_recovery()
Recovery from groundwater drought
lap_ind_extreme_months()
Timing of the annual groundwater extremes
lap_ind_flashiness()
Flashiness of the hydrograph
lap_ind_memory()
Aquifer memory (persistence)
lap_ind_phase_regularity()
Year-to-year regularity of the seasonal timing
lap_ind_recession()
Master-recession-curve e-folding time
lap_ind_recharge_discharge()
Length of the annual recharge and discharge periods
lap_ind_rise_fall()
Rising- vs falling-limb rates
lap_ind_seasonal_amplitude()
Mean within-year (seasonal) amplitude
lap_ind_seasonality_strength()
Strength of the seasonal cycle
lap_ind_step_change()
Step change (Pettitt change-point)
lap_ind_trend()
Long-term trend (mean level)
lap_ind_trend_acceleration()
Trend acceleration
lap_ind_trend_extremes()
Trend of the annual minima and maxima

Plot builders

Reusable ggplot2 chart builders. Each returns a bare ggplot (or patchwork), themed and annotated, ready to compose.

lap_plot_change_scatter()
Starting value against its change
lap_plot_delta_map()
Map the change in an indicator between two periods
lap_plot_distribution()
Distribution of one indicator across wells
lap_plot_indicator_scatter()
Two indicators against each other
lap_plot_hex_map() lap_plot_point_map()
lapidary map builders
lap_plot_period_ridges()
Stacked period distributions (ridgelines)
lap_attach_margin()
Attach a marginal distribution to a plot
lap_annotate_howto()
Add a "how to read this chart" explainer to a plot
lap_howto()
A "how to read this chart" explainer string
